items.title: Oil facilities hit in deadly overnight attack on St Petersburg

sentences.en: Oil facilities hit in deadly overnight attack on St Petersburg.
sentences.zh: 石油设施在圣彼得堡遭受致命的夜间袭击。

sentences.en: At least one person was killed in the strikes, which also hit a data centre used by Russia's equivalent of Facebook.
sentences.zh: 至少有一人在罢工中丧生，罢工还袭击了俄罗斯Facebook使用的数据中心。

items.title: Police investigate Reform mayor for allegedly sharing ‘naked and sexualised’ images of himself

sentences.en: Police investigate Reform mayor for allegedly sharing ‘naked and sexualised’ images of himself.
sentences.zh: 警方调查Reform市长涉嫌分享自己的“裸体和性感”图像。

sentences.en: Female colleague says she was forced out shortly after incident with Luke Campbell, Hull and East Yorkshire mayor A Reform UK mayor is under police investigation for allegedly showing “naked and sexualised” images of himself to a female member of staff.
sentences.zh: 女同事说，她在与卢克·坎贝尔（ Luke Campbell ）、赫尔（ Hull ）和东约克郡（ East Yorkshire ）市长发生事件后不久被迫离开。英国改革市长因涉嫌向一名女性工作人员展示“裸体和性感”的照片而受到警方调查。

sentences.en: Luke Campbell, a former Olympic boxing champion and the mayor of Hull and East Yorkshire, is understood to have been questioned under caution by Humberside police earlier this month.
sentences.zh: 据了解，前奥运会拳击冠军、赫尔和东约克郡市长卢克·坎贝尔（ Luke Campbell ）本月早些时候受到了亨伯赛德警方的审慎质疑。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Arrests over France protests rise to 1,800, with whole streets in Paris ‘devastated’ – Europe live

sentences.en: Arrests over France protests rise to 1,800, with whole streets in Paris ‘devastated’ – Europe live.
sentences.zh: 因法国抗议活动而被捕的人数上升至1,800人，巴黎的整条街道“被摧毁” –欧洲现场直播。

sentences.en: Interior minister says ‘the Republic will not yield’ to France’s worst protests in years A dispatch here from Sam Jones, our reporter in Madrid, as protests have spread to Italy and Portugal The angry protests that have convulsed Spain and France in recent weeks have spilled over to Italy and Portugal , with rioters clashing with police and setting property on fire in Milan, and a tent encampment springing up in Lisbon over the weekend.
sentences.zh: 内政部长表示， “共和国不会屈服于”法国多年来最严重的抗议活动随着抗议活动蔓延到意大利和葡萄牙，我们在马德里的记者萨姆·琼斯（ Sam Jones ）派遣到这里。最近几周震撼西班牙和法国的愤怒抗议活动已经蔓延到意大利和葡萄牙，暴徒与警察发生冲突，并在米兰放火焚烧财产，周末在里斯本涌现出一个帐篷营地。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Search for Amelia Earhart's plane resumes after stormy weather

sentences.en: Search for Amelia Earhart's plane resumes after stormy weather.
sentences.zh: 在暴风雨天气后搜索Amelia Earhart的飞机。

sentences.en: An expedition to a remote Pacific island hoping to uncover the American aviator's wreckage was on hold for three days.
sentences.zh: 前往一个偏远的太平洋岛屿的探险队希望发现美国飞行员的残骸，但被搁置了三天。

items.title: Pope Leo says he will gradually resume duties after cancer surgery

sentences.en: Pope Leo says he will gradually resume duties after cancer surgery.
sentences.zh: 教皇利奥说，他将在癌症手术后逐渐恢复工作。

sentences.en: Pope Leo XIV thanked thousands of faithful in St. Peter's Square on Sunday for their prayers while he was hospitalized, and said he plans to gradually return to his usual duties.
sentences.zh: 教皇利奥十四世周日在圣彼得广场感谢数千名信徒在他住院期间的祈祷，并表示他计划逐步恢复正常的职责。

sentences.en: (Image credit: Alessandra Tarantino)
sentences.zh: （图片来源： Alessandra Tarantino ）

items.title: European diplomats attacked by Israeli settlers in West Bank

sentences.en: European diplomats attacked by Israeli settlers in West Bank.
sentences.zh: 欧洲外交官在约旦河西岸遭到以色列定居者的袭击。

sentences.en: The Israeli military condemns the violence but the prime minister's office says it is part of a "smear" campaign.
sentences.zh: 以色列军方谴责暴力事件，但总理办公室表示，这是“诽谤”运动的一部分。

items.title: Trump defers federal diesel taxes to help farmers, but states issue warnings

sentences.en: Trump defers federal diesel taxes to help farmers, but states issue warnings.
sentences.zh: 特朗普推迟联邦柴油税以帮助农民，但各州发出警告。

sentences.en: President Trump's executive order deferring federal taxes on diesel is aimed at helping farmers but it's more complicated than it sounds and states are warning drivers they may owe taxes later.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统推迟对柴油征收联邦税的行政命令旨在帮助农民，但这比听起来更复杂，各州正在警告司机他们以后可能会欠税。

items.title: Inside the New York ‘time machine’ racing to save a century of sound and film

sentences.en: Inside the New York ‘time machine’ racing to save a century of sound and film.
sentences.zh: 在纽约“时间机器”赛车中，拯救一个世纪的声音和电影。

sentences.en: “I tell my kids I work in a time machine,” said Rhony Dostaly.
sentences.zh: “我告诉我的孩子我在时间机器上工作，” Rhony Dostaly说。

sentences.en: In a basement beneath Lincoln Center, the media preservation engineer rescues moments from the past.
sentences.zh: 在林肯中心的地下室，媒体保护工程师拯救了过去的时刻。

sentences.en: “I go back in time, and I grab elements, and I make them available for people today.”
sentences.zh: “我回到过去，我抓住了元素，并将它们提供给今天的人们。”

items.title: If you have the scratch, they have the scares

sentences.en: If you have the scratch, they have the scares.
sentences.zh: 如果你有划痕，他们就有恐惧。

sentences.en: Scary stories are more than fun, they're big business.
sentences.zh: 可怕的故事不仅仅是有趣的，它们是大生意。

sentences.en: (Image credit: Ryan Benk)
sentences.zh: （图片来源： Ryan Benk ）

items.title: Pope Leo XIV thanks wellwishers in first event after cancer surgery

sentences.en: Pope Leo XIV thanks wellwishers in first event after cancer surgery.
sentences.zh: 教皇利奥十四世在癌症手术后的第一次活动中感谢祝福者。

sentences.en: The Pope's first event since his lung cancer diagnosis and surgery saw him recite the traditional Angelus prayer from the balcony of the Apostolic Palace.
sentences.zh: 教皇在肺癌诊断和手术后的第一次活动中，他在使徒宫的阳台上背诵了传统的当归祈祷文。

items.title: Parisians wake up to protest damage and looted shops

sentences.en: Parisians wake up to protest damage and looted shops.
sentences.zh: 巴黎人醒来抗议损坏和洗劫商店。

sentences.en: Violence broke out across France on Saturday during the latest day of demonstrations against conditions in schools and the cost of living.
sentences.zh: 周六，在最近一天的抗议学校条件和生活成本的示威活动中，法国各地爆发了暴力事件。

items.title: Hilarious quips and ‘100,000-volt’ energy: the hypemen (and women) redefining Afrobeats music

sentences.en: Hilarious quips and ‘100,000-volt’ energy: the hypemen (and women) redefining Afrobeats music.
sentences.zh: 滑稽的俏皮话和“100,000伏”的能量： hypemen （和女性）重新定义了Afrobeats音乐。

sentences.en: Style of emceeing based on high-octane, ad-libbed vocals has flourished thanks to its unique way of captivating crowds For the 2015 freshmen cohort of the history degree programme at the University of Lagos, their classmate’s first-semester presentation was so captivating that they began calling him Toby Shang, after the 16th-century Chinese dynasty he had focused on.
sentences.zh: 由于其独特的吸引人群的方式，基于高辛烷值、带有广告的人声的演唱风格已经蓬勃发展。对于拉各斯大学历史学位课程的2015年新生群体，他们的同学的第一学期演讲是如此迷人，以至于他们开始称他为Toby Shang ，此前他专注于16世纪的中国王朝。

sentences.en: His crowd engagement that day had been harnessed from his high school days as a ginger-man (energiser) in a three-man band and as a private tutor.
sentences.zh: 那天，他作为一个三人乐队的姜人（能量源泉）和私人导师，从高中开始就利用了他的人群参与。

sentences.en: By his final year at university, his viral catchphrases and infectious energy had resulted in a hit song, Shedibalabala.
sentences.zh: 在大学的最后一年，他的病毒式流行语和传染性能量催生了一首热门歌曲《Shedibalabala》。

sentences.en: Today, he is one of the self-acclaimed “evangelists and pioneers” in the Afrobeats sub-genre some are now calling Afrohype or lamba.
sentences.zh: 今天，他是Afrobeats子类型中自称的“传教士和先驱者”之一，有些人现在称之为Afrohype或Lamba。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: With an ad aimed at Trump, this Republican exposed GOP angst about Latino voters

sentences.en: With an ad aimed at Trump, this Republican exposed GOP angst about Latino voters.
sentences.zh: 通过针对特朗普的广告，这位共和党人暴露了共和党对拉丁裔选民的担忧。

sentences.en: Rep.
sentences.zh: 共和国

sentences.en: María Elvira Salazar filmed an ad warning the president that he's "gone too far" on immigration.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚·埃尔维拉·萨拉萨尔（ María Elvira Salazar ）拍摄了一则广告，警告总统他在移民问题上“走得太远

sentences.en: It reflected concern among some Republicans that their gains with Latino voters could be at risk.
sentences.zh: 这反映了一些共和党人的担忧，即他们在拉丁裔选民中的收益可能面临风险。

sentences.en: (Image credit: Heather Diehl)
sentences.zh: （图片来源： Heather Diehl ）

items.title: Carney says 4 service members killed and dozens injured in fire at Alberta military base

sentences.en: Carney says 4 service members killed and dozens injured in fire at Alberta military base.
sentences.zh: 卡尼说，艾伯塔省军事基地发生火灾，造成4名军人死亡，数十人受伤。

sentences.en: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney described the incident as one of the worst peacetime tragedies for Canada's military on domestic soil.
sentences.zh: 加拿大总理马克·卡尼（ Mark Carney ）将这一事件描述为加拿大军队在国内土地上最严重的和平时期悲剧之一。

sentences.en: (Image credit: John Ulan)
sentences.zh: （图片来源： John Ulan ）

items.title: An extraordinary life: descendant welcomes biography of woman ‘gifted’ to Queen Victoria

sentences.en: An extraordinary life: descendant welcomes biography of woman ‘gifted’ to Queen Victoria.
sentences.zh: 非凡的生活： DESCENT欢迎维多利亚女王的女性“天才”传记。

sentences.en: A girl called Àìná was captured by an African king and later taken to England to become Sarah Forbes Bonetta, protege of the imperial monarch When she was seven years old, Bayo Randle’s great-great-grandmother Sarah Forbes Bonetta was presented to Queen Victoria at Windsor Castle as a “diplomatic gift” from an African king.
sentences.zh: 一个名叫Àìná的女孩被一位非洲国王俘虏，后来被带到英国成为皇帝的保护者莎拉·福布斯·博内塔（ Sarah Forbes Bonetta ）。当她七岁时，巴约·兰德尔（ Bayo Randle ）的曾曾祖母莎拉·福布斯·博内塔（ Sarah Forbes Bonetta ）在温莎城堡（ Windsor Castle ）被送给维多利亚女王，作为非洲国王的“外交礼物”。

sentences.en: Victoria would go on to pay for Bonetta’s education, approve her marriage to one of west Africa’s wealthiest men, and become godmother to her eldest daughter.
sentences.zh: 维多利亚继续支付博内塔的教育费用，批准她与西非最富有的男人之一结婚，并成为她大女儿的教母。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: ‘4,000 people minding our own business’: four decades on, Falklands again face a hostile Argentina

sentences.en: ‘4,000 people minding our own business’: four decades on, Falklands again face a hostile Argentina.
sentences.zh: “4000人关心我们自己的生意” ：四十年后，福克兰群岛再次面临敌对的阿根廷。

sentences.en: Facing a slump in the polls, Argentina’s president is making economic attacks on the islands’ oil industry, and suggesting its key fisheries industry could be next A dozen local people and a uniformed military police officer (“Do you mind if I sit in?”) took their seats at the back of the handsome wood-panelled courtroom that doubles as the Falkland Islands’ legislative assembly.
sentences.zh: 面对民意调查的低迷，阿根廷总统正在对该岛的石油工业进行经济攻击，并暗示其主要渔业可能成为下一个十几个当地人，一名穿制服的军警（ “你介意我坐吗？” ）在英俊的木板法庭后面就座，该法庭兼作福克兰群岛的立法会议。

sentences.en: Outside, it was a typically blowy early evening.
sentences.zh: 在外面，这是一个典型的吹风的傍晚。

sentences.en: It may nominally be spring in the south Atlantic, but Stanley harbour, with its dark grey water speckled with historical shipwrecks, was a cauldron of swells and churn.
sentences.zh: 名义上，它可能是南大西洋的春天，但斯坦利港（ Stanley harbour ）的深灰色水面上点缀着历史悠久的沉船，是一个汹涌和搅动的大锅。

sentences.en: Six of the assembly’s eight members – five men, one woman – waited patiently at a row of desks and microphones.
sentences.zh: 大会的八名成员中有六名--五名男性，一名女性--在一排桌子和麦克风前耐心等待。

sentences.en: The heating had been turned up to just short of uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 暖气已经打开，简直不舒服。

sentences.en: Behind them, a portrait of King Charles.
sentences.zh: 在他们身后，是查尔斯国王的肖像。

sentences.en: From the other walls, dusty photographs of governors peered down on the scene.
sentences.zh: 从其他墙上，满是灰尘的州长照片凝视着现场。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Oregon governor Tina Kotek reacts to Silver Rail Elementary school shooting

sentences.en: Oregon governor Tina Kotek reacts to Silver Rail Elementary school shooting.
sentences.zh: 俄勒冈州州长Tina Kotek对银轨小学枪击事件作出反应。

sentences.en: NPR's Joel Rose talks with Oregon Governor Tina Kotek about the shooting at Silver Rail Elementary in Bend, Oregon.
sentences.zh: NPR的乔尔·罗斯（ Joel Rose ）与俄勒冈州州长蒂娜·科特克（ Tina Kotek ）就俄勒冈州本德（ Bend ）银轨小学（ Silver Rail Elementary ）

items.title: Photos show luxury boat with 50m pool and water slides near Kim Jong Un's summer retreat

sentences.en: Photos show luxury boat with 50m pool and water slides near Kim Jong Un's summer retreat.
sentences.zh: 照片显示，金正恩（ Kim Jong Un ）的夏季度假胜地附近有豪华游艇，配备50米泳池和水滑梯。

sentences.en: Satellite images give clues about how Kim spends his holidays - something far out of reach for most North Koreans.
sentences.zh: 卫星图像提供了金正恩如何度过假期的线索--这对大多数朝鲜人来说是遥不可及的。

items.title: How day of protests unfolded as disorder breaks out across France

sentences.en: How day of protests unfolded as disorder breaks out across France.
sentences.zh: 随着法国各地的骚乱爆发，抗议日是如何展开的。

sentences.en: Demonstrations across the country turned violent, with cars and buildings set alight and shops ransacked.
sentences.zh: 全国各地的示威活动演变成暴力事件，汽车和建筑物被点燃，商店被洗劫一空。

items.title: Anti-government protesters battle with police in Albania

sentences.en: Anti-government protesters battle with police in Albania.
sentences.zh: 在阿尔巴尼亚，反政府抗议者与警方发生冲突。

sentences.en: There were violent clashes between demonstrators and riot police throughout Saturday in the capital Tirana.
sentences.zh: 整个星期六，示威者和防暴警察在首都地拉那发生了暴力冲突。

items.title: Israeli settlers attack European diplomats in West Bank

sentences.en: Israeli settlers attack European diplomats in West Bank.
sentences.zh: 以色列定居者袭击了约旦河西岸的欧洲外交官。

sentences.en: French mayor and archbishop also attacked during violent attempt to stop Palestinians harvesting olives Israeli settler militants have attacked European diplomats, a French mayor and the archbishop of Cambrai in Taybeh, in the occupied West Bank, injuring three people and damaging a car, in the latest violent attempt to prevent Palestinians from harvesting olives on their own land.
sentences.zh: 在阻止巴勒斯坦人收获橄榄的暴力企图中，法国市长和大主教以色列定居者武装分子还袭击了欧洲外交官、法国市长和被占领的约旦河西岸Taybeh的康布雷大主教，造成三人受伤，一辆汽车受损，这是阻止巴勒斯坦人在自己的土地上收获橄榄的最新暴力企图。

sentences.en: Bernard Baudoux, mayor of Aulnoye-Aymeries, was wearing his red, white and blue sash of office and attempting to enter a vehicle with diplomatic plates when he was assaulted and knocked to the ground on Saturday.
sentences.zh: Aulnoye-Aymeries市长Bernard Baudoux在周六遭到殴打并被撞倒在地时，戴着红色、白色和蓝色的办公室腰带，试图进入一辆带有外交牌照的车辆。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
